DCMSHRIRAM.NS.d: DCM Shriram Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in chloro-vinyl, sugar, agri-input, and other businesses in India and internationally. The company operates through Fertilisers, Chloro-Vinyl, Shriram Farm Solution, Sugar, Bioseed, and Others segments.

DOLATALGO.NS.d: Dolat Algotech Ltd. trades in commodities, shares and securities and engages in other financial intermediation. Founded on February 24, 1983, it is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

DVL.NS.d: Dhunseri Ventures Limited primarily engages in the trading operations of PET resin. The company operates in two segments, Treasury Operations and Trading. It also undertakes treasury operations in shares and securities of other bodies corporate; develops and provides infrastructure facilities in special economic zones for information technology and information technology enabled services; and manufactures and retails confectioneries.

DYCL.NS.d: Dynamic Cables Limited produces and distributes electrical cables and conductors for public and private sector clients in India and globally. Its conductors include aluminum alloy, ACSR, all-aluminum and bare copper types, alongside a broader range of cables.

EKC.NS.d: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cylinders primarily in India. The company offers compressed natural gas steel, industrial gas, fire extinguisher, fire suppression system, medical application, hydrogen, breathing air, aluminum, jumbo, and type-4 cylinders. It also provides equipment, appliances, and tanks, as well as parts and accessories used for containing and storage of gas, liquids, and air.

ELECTHERM.NS.d: Electrotherm (India) Limited manufactures and markets induction furnace, casting machines, transformers, sponge and pig iron, ferrous and non-ferrous billets/bars/ingots, ductile iron pipes, transmission line towers, and battery operated vehicles in India and internationally. It operates through Engineering & Project, Special Steel, and Electric Vehicle divisions.

FILATEX.NS.d: Filatex India Limited manufactures and trades in synthetic yarns and textiles primarily in India. The company offers partially oriented yarns, which are used in shirtings and suitings, sarees, ladies' dress materials, and knitwear; polyester textured yarns that are used to produce fabrics and textiles for high-end apparel, high-end sports shoes, sports bags, home furnishings, and zipper tapes; and fully drawn yarns (FDYs) are used in making fabrics and textiles for high-end undergarments, high-end sportswear, and…

GREENPOWER.NS.d: Orient Green Power Company Limited, an independent renewable energy power producing company, develops, owns, and operates a portfolio of wind energy power plants in India. It has a portfolio of 421 MW of wind energy across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, and Karnataka, as well as 10.5 MW wind power plant in Croatia. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

HECPROJECT.NS.d: HEC Infra Projects Limited, established in Ahmedabad in 2005, is an engineering, procurement and construction firm specialising in electro-mechanical and instrumentation projects in India. Its work includes substations and switchyards, overhead transmission lines, cable laying and water management systems.

HGS.NS.d: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited provides business process management services in the United States, Canada, Europe, India, and internationally. The company provides a suite of digital innovation solutions, including voice/IVR, email, chat, text, social, self-service, mobile camera support, mobile messaging, and work at home, as well as analytics, automation, and digital marketing solutions. It also offers business process optimization solutions, such as back-office, human resources outsourcing, and B2B.

ICICIPRULI.NS.d: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited provides life insurance, pension, and health insurance products to individuals and groups in India. It offers participating, non-participating non-linked, and non-participating linked. The company also provides term life, health, savings, and retirement insurance products; and pension fund management services. It distributes its products through individual and corporate agents, banks, and brokers, as well as through its own sales force and website.

IFGLEXPOR.NS.d: IFGL Refractories Limited engages in the manufacture, trade, and sale of refractory items used in steel plants in India and internationally. The company offers isostatic and slide gate refractories, tube changer systems, and purging systems refractories; cast products and monolithics, zircon and zircona nozzles, spray machines, robotic gunning, and slag control darts and machines; and foundry ceramics, wire guides, and heating ovens.

INA.NS.d: Insolation Energy Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker INA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

INNOVACAP.NS.d: Innova Captab Limited, established in Panchkula, India, in 2005, is a pharmaceutical company covering research and development, manufacturing, distribution and marketing for domestic and international markets. It also provides contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) services to other pharmaceutical firms.

INNOVATIVE-SM.NS.d: Innovative Tyres & is a company involved in the tyre retreading industry in India. They focus on providing tyre retreading services for various types of vehicles. The company is based in India.

JNPR.NS.d: Juniper Green Energy Ltd. is an independent renewable power producer and operator. Its projects include wind, solar, wind-solar hybrid, firm and dispatchable renewable energy, and battery energy storage. It develops, builds and operates these projects and offers engineering, procurement, construction and operations services.

JSL.NS.d: Jindal Stainless Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel products in India and internationally. The company provides ferro alloys, slabs, hot rolled coils, plates and sheets, and cold rolled coils and sheets. Its products are used in automobile, railway, household/durables, building and construction, nuclear, and processing industries. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in New Delhi, India.

JUBLCPL.NS.d: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (JACL) makes and supplies performance polymers, chemicals and agricultural products in India and abroad. Founded in Gurugram in 2008, it has three units: polymers and chemicals, P&K fertilizers, and agri nutrients. Its consumer line includes woodworking adhesives and finishes under brands such as Jivanjor, Vamicol and Charmwood, plus maintenance products.

JWL.NS.d: Jupiter Wagons Limited, founded in 1979 and headquartered in Kolkata, makes and sells transportation equipment in India, Europe and North America. Its products include freight wagons of open, covered, flat, hopper and container types, plus wagon accessories such as cast alloy steel bogies and centre buffer couplers.

KCP.NS.d: The KCP Limited engages in the cement, heavy engineering, power generation, and hospitality businesses in India and Vietnam. It operates through Cement unit, Engineering Unit, Power Generation unit, and Hotel segments. The company manufactures and sells cement; a range of heavy equipment for various industries, such as cement, sugar, power, mining (minerals), mineral processing, metal, oil and gas, chemicals and fertilizers, defense, space, industrial gases, and general engineering.

KCPSUGIND.NS.d: K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sugar and allied products in India and internationally. It also provides bio fertilizers; chemicals comprising industrial alcohol, carbon dioxide, and calcium lactate, as well as organic manure and mycorrhiza vam products; and rectified spirit, extra neutral alcohol, and ethanol.

KPIL.NS.d: Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) provides engineering, procurement and construction services globally. It works on transmission and distribution of power, civil construction covering buildings, roads and water infrastructure, railways, and oil and gas pipelines, across India and many other countries. It has EPC and developmental project segments and delivers turnkey solutions.

LIKHITHA.NS.d: Likhitha Infrastructure Limited engages in laying, testing, and commissioning of oil and gas pipe lines in India. The company is also involved in laying of oil and gas supply pipe lines and irrigation canals, building bridges over the canals, and related maintenance works; and the provision of operations and maintenance services for city gas distribution companies. Likhitha Infrastructure Limited was founded in 1998 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

MALLCOM.NS.d: Mallcom (India) Limited and its subsidiaries make and distribute personal protective equipment worldwide. Its head protection products include safety eyewear, ear defenders, face shields and helmets, and its hand protection includes gloves of latex, nitrile, leather, knitted and other materials.

MAXHEALTH.NS.d: Max Healthcare Institute Limited provides healthcare services in India. It offers services in various specialties, including cancer care/oncology, liver transplant and biliary sciences, cardiac sciences, neuro sciences, orthopaedics, bariatric/weight loss surgery, minimal access/laparoscopic surgery, bone marrow transplant, kidney transplant, nephrology, and aesthetic and reconstructive surgery.

METROBRAND.NS.d: Metro Brands Limited is a leading footwear retailer in India selling shoes for men, women and children. It offers its own brands, including Metro, Mochi, Walkway and Da Vinchi, together with third-party names such as Crocs, Skechers, Clarks and Fitflop, plus accessories and shoe-care products. Sales run through stores, distribution channels and online platforms.

NBCC.NS.d: NBCC (India) Limited engages in project management consultancy and real estate development businesses in India and internationally. The company also provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracting services.

NUCLEUS.NS.d: Nucleus Software Exports Limited provides software solutions in India, the Far East, South East Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, and internationally.

OLECTRA.NS.d: Olectra Greentech Limited manufactures and supplies composite polymer insulators in India. The company operates through Composite Polymer Insulators and Electric Buses segments. It manufactures 1200kV, 330-420kV, 220-245kV, 110-132kV, 52-77kV, 33-36kV, 22-28kV, and 10-15kV insulators for transmission and distribution; and tonne, bracket tube, and stay arm insulators for railways. The also manufactures, markets, and sells electrical buses.

RADIOCITY.NS.d: Music Broadcast Limited owns and operates FM radio stations under the Radio City brand name. Its radio stations deliver film, non-film, devotional, regional, and international music. The company operates 28 radio stations in 39 cities in India. It also operates radio stations that offer entertainment news, movie reviews, and photo galleries. In addition, the company operates online platform radiocity.in, which has 18 radio stations in 9 languages; and ‘Radio City' youtube channels.

RENUKA.NS.d: Shree Renuka Sugars Limited manufactures and refines sugar in India and internationally. The company provides white/refined sugar, as well as by-products, including molasses, bagasse, press mud, and organic manure; and ethyl alcohol from molasses and fuel grade ethanol from sugarcane juice. It also produces power from bagasse, a sugarcane byproduct for state grids. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Belgaum, India. Shree Renuka Sugars Limited is a subsidiary of Wilmar Sugar Holdings Pte. Ltd.

RITEZONE.NS.d: Rite Zone Chemcon India Ltd. manufactures and sells a range of construction and concrete chemical products. The company offers solutions for civil construction, infrastructure, and building and structure projects, covering both pre-construction and post-construction needs.

ROHLTD.NS.d: Royal Orchid Hotels Limited operates and manages hotels and resorts in India. The company also provides restaurants and mobile food services. It operates 58 hotels and resorts with approximately 3,920 guest rooms, as well as 110 restaurants and bars in 39 cities. The company was formerly known as Universal Resorts Limited and changed its name to Royal Orchid Hotels Limited in 1997. Royal Orchid Hotels Limited was founded in 1973 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

RUPA.NS.d: Rupa & Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells hosiery products for men, women, and kids in India and internationally. It offers vests, briefs, drawers, bermudas, capri's, T-shirts, loungers, boxer shorts, sleep wear, socks, and thermals for men; bras, panties, camisole, leggings, T-shirts, capri's, loungers, thermal uppers and lowers, and socks for women; vests, briefs, drawers, T-shirts, bermudas, capri's, loungers, thermals, and socks for kids; and plus baba suits and frocks for…

SHAHINVEST.NS.d: Shah Investor's Home Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHAHINVEST and traded in INR. Its country is India.

STARPAPER.NS.d: Star Paper Mills Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of paper and paper products in India and internationally. It offers a range of cultural papers, industrial and packaging papers, and other grades. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Kolkata, India.

SUNDRMBRAK.NS.d: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited manufactures and sells asbestos free friction materials in India. The company's products include brake linings, brake pads, clutch facings, and PV linings and pads. Its products are used in commercial vehicles, passenger cars, agricultural tractors, railways, and two wheelers. The company also exports its products to approximately 54 countries worldwide. Sundaram Brake Linings Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

SUNDROP.NS.d: Sundrop Brands Limited, established in 1986 and headquartered in Gurugram, India, works in domestic and international markets for edible oil and food products. It was previously named Agro Tech Foods Limited and produces, markets and distributes a range of food products.

SUPREMEINF.NS.d: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the engineering and construction of road, rail, highway, building, bridge, irrigation, power, and sewerage projects in India. The company owns and operates ready mix concrete, asphalt, and crushing plants. It also rents staging, scaffolding, shuttering steel pipes; and offers structural fabrications, steel fabrications, and job works. In addition, the company is involved in the tolling operations.

SURANI.NS.d: Surani Steel Tubes Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer and supplier of Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) Mild Steel (MS) pipes and steel tubes, operating primarily within the steel processing industry. The company's main products include various forms of mild steel pipes such as round, square, rectangular, and structural pipes, as well as mild steel hollow sections and mild steel coils, including hot rolled and slit coils.

SWANCORP.NS.d: Swan Corp Limited is a diversified Indian group with an international presence that mainly makes and distributes textiles such as cotton, polyester cotton, linen and viscose fabrics. Its segments include Textiles, Energy, Construction and Others, Distribution and Development, Warehousing, Manufacturing and power generation.

SWANDEF.NS.d: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited builds vessels, repairs and refurbishes ships and rigs, and does heavy engineering for Indian and international clients. Its vessels include naval defence vessels, niche craft, cargo carriers and large commercial ships.

TATAELXSI.NS.d: Tata Elxsi Limited provides product design and engineering, and systems integration and support services in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Software Development and Services; and Systems Integration and Support.

TNTELE.NS.d: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited manufactures and sells optical fiber cables for telecommunications in India. Its products include nylon jacketed metal-free optical fiber cables for use in saline atmosphere in coastal areas; armored optical fiber cables for direct burial application; self-supporting aerial optical fiber cables; composite cables; and ribbon cables. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Maraimalai Nagar, India.

TOKYOPLAST.NS.d: Tokyo Plast International Limited designs, manufactures, and sells thermo food containers and coolers under the PINNACLE brand name in India and internationally. The company provides insulated water jugs, cooler boxes, ice chests, insulated casseroles, and food warmers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1992 is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

UNIDT.NS.d: United Drilling Tools Limited manufactures and sells wire line and well service equipment, gas lift equipment, downhole tools, and OD casing pipes and connectors worldwide. The company offers wireline winch units, including slimsplit, flyline, surveyline, truckline, landline, and wireline accessories; down hole tools, such as interchangeable sleeve stabilizers, integral blade stabilizers, rotary reamers, subs, and lifting subs and plugs; and fast make up high performance connectors.

VASWANI.NS.d: Vaswani Industries Limited manufactures and trades in iron ore pellets, sponge iron, steel billets, HB wires, and ingots in India. The company operates through Iron & Steel, and Power segments. It also generates power through waste heat recovery boilers with an installed capacity of 11.5 megawatts. Vaswani Industries Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Raipur, India.

VEEKAYEM.NS.d: Veekayem Fashion & Apparels Ltd. is an India-based company operating within the textile and garment industry. The company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a diverse range of fabrics and readymade garments. Its business operations encompass weaving, processing, dyeing, printing, finishing, and garment manufacturing.

VIVIANA.NS.d: Viviana Power Tech Ltd. works mainly in power transmission, distribution and industrial EPC. It supplies, erects, tests and commissions transmission lines, extra high voltage substations and electrical systems for industrial, commercial and residential users, and also establishes power distribution networks.

WINSOL.NS.d: Winsol Engineers Ltd. operates in the renewable energy sector, specializing in wind and solar power projects. The company provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning (EPCC) services, which encompass site evaluation, resource assessment, feasibility analysis, design, and construction of both wind and solar power plants.
